typical_symptoms: Reddish-brown discoloration along the midrib and leaf blade
Elongated necrotic lesions and spots containing rust-colored pustules
Drying and premature death of heavily infected leaves
visual_characteristics: Elongated reddish streaks running parallel to veins
Clusters of brownish-orange to rust-colored spots on the leaf surface
Extensive necrotic tissue breakdown along one side of the leaf blade
lesion_characteristics: Elongated streaks and irregular oval spots
Undefined or diffuse margins merging into chlorotic areas
color_characteristics: Dark greyish-brown to black necrotic patches in advanced stages
texture_characteristics: Powdery spore masses on the underside of lesions
Dry, papery, and brittle necrotic leaf tissue
Rough surface due to raised pustules
spatial_patterns: Linear streaks running parallel to the leaf veins
Scattered small pustules coalescing into larger blighted patches along the midrib
distinguishing_features: Striking red coloration along the midrib accompanied by powdery rust spore pustules
